categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in four core business segments: antenna products, thermal management devices and modules, wiring harnesses and connectors, and smart modules. These products serve industries including consumer electronics, automotive, communications, and new energy sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as FPC antennas, LDS antennas formed by laser direct structuring, and high-precision automotive positioning antennas. Manufacturing follows ISO9001 standards with ERP system management, emphasizing customized production based on customer orders and continuous innovation in antenna design, thermal solutions, and sensor modules.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international firms in smartphone, PC, automotive, and industrial sectors. The company serves major markets such as mobile communications, automotive electronics (including new energy vehicles), consumer electronics, and industrial control, with strategic partnerships in 5G, AI terminals, and automotive smart connectivity.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales cover China extensively, with production bases in the Pearl River Delta, Yangtze River Delta, and Southeast Asia. The company has established overseas subsidiaries and offices in Taiwan, South Korea, the United States, Vietnam, and Hong Kong to support global market expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on R&D, manufacturing, and direct sales of key components such as antennas, thermal modules, wiring harnesses, and smart sensor modules to OEMs and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening core business focus on antennas, thermal modules, wiring harnesses, and smart modules, increasing R&D investment especially in 5G, AI, and automotive smart technologies, and enhancing internal management for high-quality growth. The company actively pursues innovation in metal frame 5G antennas, transparent antennas, and AI terminal thermal solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of customized wireless communication antennas, thermal management products, wiring harnesses, and smart modules. The company follows a make-to-order production model, with revenue recognized upon transfer of control to customers, primarily via product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a leading provider of core components in wireless communication and automotive electronics, leveraging strong R&D capabilities, diversified product lines, and strategic customer relationships to maintain competitive advantages in the 5G and new energy vehicle markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.86 billion, a 12.37% increase over the prior year, though it continued to incur net losses with improved profitability trends. Total assets reached about RMB 3.06 billion, with ongoing investments in R&D accounting for nearly 9% of revenue. The company has experienced a gradual recovery in operating performance with focused cost control and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its technological innovation, high-quality manufacturing, and customized product solutions as key differentiators. Its extensive patent portfolio, advanced antenna and thermal technologies, and integrated smart module offerings provide customers with enhanced product performance, reliability, and adaptability to emerging 5G, AI, and automotive smart connectivity demands.
